test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.**

The query isn't (whether he will admit it, but when).

options.text: whether he will be admitting it or not, but when?
whether or nor he will admit it, but when?
whether he will admit it or not, but when?

solution:
**Correct Answer: (4) whether he will admit it or not, but when?**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**The phrase **"whether he will admit it or not, but when?"** is grammatically correct and makes the sentence more coherent. It clearly contrasts the uncertainty of when he will admit something, rather than focusing on whether he will admit it in the first place.
